fields.description: Issue features extensive coverage of the death of Mary Jane Korn and allegations against Dr. T. E. Moore ("Torture Doctor"), including discussion of documentary evidence, police/coroner discrepancies, and calls for renewed investigation and action by state authorities. Additional content includes commentary on Florida politics and gambling enforcement, letters and reporting on Miami Beach rent increases after decontrol, local employment and business conditions, and assorted local court/police items, along with entertainment and nightlife advertisements and listings.
